packages.section: Part C §7 "F-motion", as amended by Part A §A20 (F-motion never changes a move clip: every move clip hashed key for key), with §A12's C12 (extremes, F-motion's act), §A9 (where tunables go) and Part B's J8 and J9 (in motion at 1 m)
packages.note: You own game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd, game/actors/placeholder_anims.gd, game/actors/poses/*.gd, new tests/test_motion_m4.gd (with any fixture it needs under tests/fixtures/motion/), new tests/bot/acts/look_motion_acts.gd (titles start 'Look:'; no title contains or is contained in another act's), your own 'Motion' subgroup in tuning_data.gd's Look group (breathing amplitude and rate, the guard bounce, head micro-motion: feel numbers are tunables, never script constants), and docs/milestones/M4-calls/F-motion.md. Steps: (1) FIRST, before changing anything, hash every clip in PlaceholderAnims.MOVE_IDS and every enemy move clip (punk_jab, punk_cross, punk_shove and the Kicker, Thug, Bruiser and Boss moves) key for key, commit the table, and make test_motion_m4 compare against it: A20's hashed clips stay identical to the end. (2) Cubic rotation interpolation (Animation.INTERPOLATION_CUBIC) and eased in-between keys only on the named non-move clips: idles, walks, run, taunt, brace, flinches, get-ups and downed. Every active-frame and contact pose is a key and stays the key. (3) Life: breathing in the idles (Chest/UpperChest about 1-2 degrees at about 0.25 Hz), a boxer bounce and weight shift for the enemy guard (Hips about 1 cm, the knees compensating so resolve_hips keeps the soles planted), head micro-motion; the player's relaxed idle calmer (its first-person tests decide how much). (4) Overlap: head and shoulder lead and lag keys on the flinches only (A20: never on punk_jab, punk_cross or punk_shove). (5) Walks: counter-swing and hip roll; foot slide of the ART's soles in planted frames (measured with skinned_view.gd) at most 2 cm per step, else match the walk clip's stride to punk_speed_mult (change the clip, not the tunable). (6) A20's limits: idle hurtboxes move less than 1 cm; the named-library cache key keeps its shape; the enemy-move checks and telegraph tests pass unchanged; every existing test passes untouched (log any test you must change, old -> new with a twin). (7) Deformation must not get worse: print test_art_punk's A19 figures for every clip you changed before and after, and keep the breathing and bounce away from the shoulder's worst range. (8) tests/test_motion_m4.gd: move clips identical to the hash table, key poses identical at active frames, no hurtbox change at an active frame, idle hurtbox motion under 1 cm, the slide bound, no pop at a loop seam (the first and last keys of every looped clip you touched agree). (9) Captures: look_motion_acts.gd with C12 'Look: extremes' (slug c12: the full arm raise, the spine twist, a deep knee bend, the hold's knee, the KO and downed lying poses and test_art_punk's peak flexes, each held and turned at 1 m) and the motion acts at 1 m at 12 fps (the idle breathing, the guard bounce and weight shift, walk and strafe, the flinches, the get-up). Re-record C3 and C5 too and compare them with the before pack at the same labels. Look at the 12 fps sheets in first person and say honestly whether they read alive and not pose-to-pose, with no pops at loop seams or between clips and the feet planted.
